desc: This marble statuette resembles a trumpeting elephant. It can become an @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmElephant000000]{Elephant} for up to 24 hours. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.
This item's limited uses represent the 7 days required before the figurine can be used again.
name: marble elephant
